tiles.design: One soft diagonal tracked-vehicle impression, from upper-left interior to lower-right interior, fading before the perimeter; sparse rusty nuts and a bent washer near lower-left interior.
Two offset short vertical tread impressions centered inside the tile, interrupted by granular white crust; three small rusty bolt heads and one short broken strip near upper-right interior.
A broad curved track arc across the central lower half, shallow and worn, with one half-buried crescent-shaped rusty plate and tiny screws near center-left.
A darker horizontal tread segment confined to the center, a small cluster of corroded washers, a short spring and a narrow iron shard near lower-right interior.
A Y-shaped cluster of deep central fractures, very sparse metal: just two small rusted nuts and a rivet. No obvious track impression.
A star-like irregular fracture junction slightly right of center, pale flaking ground, a small bent rusted angle bracket and scattered pin-sized fragments. No tread.
A network of long branching diagonal cracks and a small oval charcoal abrasion patch at upper-left interior; a handful of widely spaced bolts. No tread.
A relatively intact broad central slab with hairline crazing, one localized rust stain around two washers and one tiny torn steel fragment; quiet low-density variant.
A partial paired tread print angled up-right, with one track stronger than the other; a rusted circular flange fragment and two bent pins in opposite central quadrants.
Two crossing shallow tread segments near center, one diagonal and one almost horizontal, with a few flat rectangular rusty fragments separated widely.
A single short curved tread print at upper-right interior; clustered corroded rings, washers and rounded bolt heads around lower-left interior, surrounded by chipped white crust.
A faded near-vertical track in center-left; a shallow oblique central fissure; a small crushed perforated steel strip and a few rusty screw heads center-right.
Scrap-focused: irregular torn rusted steel plate pieces and small rivets in two loose interior clusters, with a thin jagged central fissure. No obvious tread.
Scrap-focused: a broken circular bearing ring, a few washers and two bent rods all well inside the center, lightly dusted with white mineral crust. Very faint short tread scuff.
Scrap-focused: short angular iron brackets, bolt shanks and one narrow curved metal shard, scattered asymmetrically around an open white central patch. No tread.
Scrap-focused: a small partly buried gear fragment, flat corroded strips and tiny reddish flakes concentrated center-bottom, fine cracks fanning upward. No tread.
An elongated charcoal-black abrasion or old scorch at upper-right interior, a short fading diagonal tread below center, two orange-rust washers near center-left.
Multiple isolated dark dusty scuffs, a curved hairline crack enclosing a central slab, one small bent metal hook and several small bolts; no dominant tread.
A densely crazed central patch of chipped white ceramic with a modest mix of rusty screws, tiny flat scraps and a broken ring; a very faint horizontal tread remnant.
A broad S-shaped irregular central fissure with two short incomplete tread segments on different sides, sparse rusty nuts and a bent strip near the central lower half.
